ui.agents.refusals.name_taken.tone: Explain remedy without backend operation jargon
ui.agents.refusals.name_taken.length_hint: Two compact sentences in a field error
ui.agents.refusals.name_taken.note: Names the existing local agent using curly quotes; suggests another name or opening the existing agent.

placeholders.name: Registry name captured from the known English refusal; interpolate unchanged between the message’s curly quotes.

ui.agents.refusals.name_grammar.note: Spaces and slashes are invalid in stored profile names; regex detection remains English and unchanged.

ui.agents.refusals.effort_unavailable.note: The supplied tier is unconfigured; inherit is a technical choice label and Settings is the configuration page.

placeholders.tier: Unconfigured effort-tier identifier captured from the backend refusal; do not translate the identifier.

ui.agents.refusals.team_name_bound.note: Preserve the inclusive 1-64 character range; this is not the agent-name rule.

ui.agents.refusals.missing_manager.note: Manager identity matches neither an agent nor a team in the local registry.

placeholders.name: Registry name captured from the known English refusal; interpolate unchanged between the message’s curly quotes.

ui.agents.refusals.missing_member.note: A member identity matches neither an agent nor a team in the local registry.

placeholders.name: Registry name captured from the known English refusal; interpolate unchanged between the message’s curly quotes.

ui.agents.refusals.team_nesting.note: The team would exceed allowed nesting or contain itself. Direct the reader to check members without inventing a particular culprit.

ui.agents.refusals.class.label.proactive.note: This is the display label only; the wire value proactive stays unchanged.

ui.agents.refusals.class.label.reactive.note: This is the display label only; the wire value reactive stays unchanged.

ui.agents.refusals.class.meaning.proacti.length_hint: Long paragraph beside the class control; wraps
ui.agents.refusals.class.meaning.proacti.note: Must retain bounded nudging with growing gaps and independent scheduled wakes; it does not promise unlimited retries.

ui.agents.refusals.class.meaning.reactiv.length_hint: Two short sentences beside class control; wraps
ui.agents.refusals.class.meaning.reactiv.note: No nudges and no independent schedule wakes; do not overstate this as never writing first in any circumstance.

ui.agents.refusals.class.effect.proactiv.length_hint: Two sentences beside the toggle; wraps
ui.agents.refusals.class.effect.proactiv.note: Stops nudges and scheduled wakes, but still replies in ordinary chat. Key names current class, not target class.

ui.agents.refusals.class.effect.reactive.length_hint: Long paragraph beside the toggle; wraps
ui.agents.refusals.class.effect.reactive.note: Enables bounded nudges and independent scheduled wakes while ordinary replies remain available. Key names current class, not target class.

ui.agents.refusals.class.install_disclos.role: Install-first disclosure on built-in class toggle
ui.agents.refusals.class.install_disclos.tone: Explain prerequisite side effect before action
ui.agents.refusals.class.install_disclos.length_hint: Long paragraph near the built-in toggle; wraps
ui.agents.refusals.class.install_disclos.note: Switching an uninstalled packaged agent first installs an editable local copy with the same identity/instructions, then writes the class.

ui.agents.refusals.class.error.no_reason.role: Fallback class-switch refusal when backend supplied no reason
ui.agents.refusals.class.error.no_reason.tone: Actionable failure without echoing the heading
ui.agents.refusals.class.error.no_reason.length_hint: Two short sentences in the control alert
ui.agents.refusals.class.error.no_reason.note: Used only for absent/unreadable exception messages; recommends retrying the switch.

ui.agents.refusals.class.error.install_l.role: Class-switch refusal after successful install prerequisite
ui.agents.refusals.class.error.install_l.tone: Separate observed install fact from uncertain class-write result
ui.agents.refusals.class.error.install_l.length_hint: Error reason plus one short result sentence; wraps
ui.agents.refusals.class.error.install_l.note: Only claims the install succeeded and the agent is editable. Does not claim class stayed unchanged: a failed response may follow a committed write.

placeholders.reason: Already adapted/localized backend refusal sentence, or the no-reason fallback; interpolate once without replacing or translating arbitrary backend data.
